# Crisp Video

> Crisp Video restores, denoises and upscales old, low-res video up to 4K offline on a Mac or a Windows PC, then lets you edit it on a real timeline. Free to use: upscaling, restoring and colour exports up to 15 seconds, everything else at full length, video and GIF exports with a small “crispvideo.app” mark. Black Friday sale: $9.99 once through December 2. Then $29. No subscription. Mac: macOS 14.0 or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or later). Windows: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, with graphics that support Vulkan (most PCs from 2016 on have them).

## Is Crisp free?

Free

- The whole app on Mac and Windows, offline, with no account and no time limit.
- The full editor and preview.
- Every export at full length, except enhanced videos (upscaled, restored or coloured), which stop at 15 seconds.
- Free video exports carry a small "crispvideo.app" mark.
- Photo upscales on a Mac never carry a mark. One photo at a time.

Pro adds

- Enhanced videos at full length.
- No mark.
- Batch processing to queue a whole folder. The free version does one at a time.
- Max, the strongest restore, on Macs that can run it. It is slow; what it needs is on the download page.

## Product and pricing
- Already bought? Click Unlock Pro in Crisp and paste the key from your email. If Unlock Pro doesn't open, choose Crisp > Enter Your Key… from the menu bar on a Mac, or Help > Enter Your Key… on Windows.

- [Pricing](https://crispvideo.app/#pricing): Free: the full editor, the full preview and the standard enhancement lanes; upscaling, restoring and colour exports stop at 15 seconds, everything else runs at full length, and every video export carries a small “crispvideo.app” mark. Pro: Black Friday sale: $9.99 once through December 2. Then $29. Every 1.x update included; removes the mark and the limit and adds batch processing and, on a Mac, the generative Max lane
- [Black Friday sale](https://crispvideo.app/#buy): Black Friday sale: $9.99 once through December 2. Then $29. The Buy button applies the sale price.
- [System requirements](https://crispvideo.app/#download): Mac: macOS 14.0 or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or later); Windows: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, with graphics that support Vulkan (most PCs from 2016 on have them)
- [Licence terms](https://crispvideo.app/legal/terms/): one Pro licence runs on up to 3 computers at a time, Mac or Windows
- [Refunds](https://crispvideo.app/legal/refunds/): email within 30 days of purchase for a refund, no reason needed
- [Download for Mac](https://github.com/mattkerr09/crisp-site/releases/download/v1/Crisp.dmg): the current release, 1.0.2151
